title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Marine-Pollutant Surcharge Amount to Book
content:
## Clause

The marine-pollutant amount to book on a Dangerous Goods Acceptance file is the category's rate per container multiplied by the acceptance's containers, stated to two decimal places — provided that three things hold together: the goods are marked marine pollutant, the goods count as loaded for this charge, and no marine-pollutant entry sits on the account so far. If any of the three fails, the amount is 0.00.

## Truth table

| Marked | Loaded for this charge | Entry already on the account | Amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | no | rate multiplied by containers |
| yes | yes | yes | 0.00 |
| yes | no | any | 0.00 |
| no | any | any | 0.00 |

## Illustration (invented rate)

With a rate of 64.50 per container and 3 containers, marked and loaded and with no entry yet: 64.50 multiplied by 3 gives 193.50.
